rules.accepted_credit_types: AMA PRA Category 1 from sponsors accredited by ACCME or an ACCME-recognized state medical society; equivalent Category 1 hours of the AOA, the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada, or organizations with reciprocal arrangements with the AMA PRA
rules.new_licensee_rule: The first three-year cycle starts on the first day of the birth month after initial licensure; CME taken between licensure and that date may count toward the first cycle.
rules.alternatives: The Board accepts (re)certification or current Maintenance of Certification/Competency (MOC) or Osteopathic Continuous Certification (OCC) issued by ABMS, RCPSC or AOA in lieu of CME (Board policy 3-12-2011; Minn. R. 5605.0700). Exempt: Emeritus registration and full-time residency or fellowship training at an accredited facility.
rules.audit_note: Signed compliance statement at the relicensure ending the cycle; the board may require additional evidence.
rules.notes: Three-year CME cycles start on the first day of the birth month. Minn. Stat. 214.12 subd. 3 asks the board to require fetal alcohol syndrome education for physicians treating it (not found in ch. 5605). Board CE pages checked 2026-10-28; rule text from the Revisor.
